request: Draw a lighthouse on a rocky coast at sunset

text.note: Clear lighthouse, rocks and sunset with a good water reflection. The lantern has no gallery railing. The rock ends in an abrupt vertical cut at the right, and its faint facets look muddy.

shot-half.note: Clean tower with railing, a nice sun reflection column and soft clouds. The rock has the same abrupt flat right edge, the shading is plain, and the small wave squiggles look weak.

shot-full.note: The richest version, with stars, a faceted rock, foam, a railing and a glowing lamp. The flat cloud ellipses cross the sun oddly, and the rock is cut off abruptly at the right.
Lighthouse with beams, faceted rock, and sunset reflection are all clear. Stray ripple marks are drawn on top of the rock at bottom right, and the haze bands look flat.

shot-half.note: Clean composition with soft clouds, rim-lit rock and a strong sun reflection. The surf marks sit slightly over the rock edge, and the tiny windows look sparse.

text.note: Good faceted rock and warm sun, but a window overlaps the door and the stars run in odd diagonal streaks.
